title: Took too long to grill, use a grill pan on your stove instead, its Less messy, and less money.
text:
Took too long to grill, use a grill pan on your stove instead, its Less messy, and less money.. Nice looking indoor, outdoor Hamilton beach grill...
Thats about all it is. Is a gimmick, and looks cute.
Cooks enough for two people, or 3 !

There is Not any numbers on the dial, or to show which way to turn this on! You just have to turn it all the around hopefully its going to cook Your food right, and its going in the right direction.
I let this warm up for 10mins as it said ( although I did it longer) it took over one hour to grill 2 deboned, deskined chicken breasts, yes they had grill marks!
And Almost 2 hours for 3 chicken wings that Never really got crispy, although they where finally done enough to eat safely.

Sitting this on my stove top, it did get some grease on the back of my stainless stove, that I just cleaned that day.
So if you put this on your counter, wipe down your counter after using this.

I’m disapointed in this grill, and think it’s senseless when I could have just use a grill pan on my stove top which works better and faster then this, and the calphalon grill pan is less money.

The Hamilton beach has a non-stick coating on the grill , is easy to clean but takes time, but not sure if its BPA Free!
The bottom part you set the grill into is all plastic. I did put water in the bottom as suggested after I read the
Instructions on Amazon. I always put water in the bottom of pyrex when I do a stand up whole chicken in the oven etc.
As then Nothing sticks.
To use this I had to set this on my stove with the over-head fan going so it would not set off my fire alarms in my house,
And I have a open kitchen, with high ceilings.

I think this is pricey for what it is.
2 stars..

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Electric Indoor, 100 sq. in. Surface Serves 8, Virtually Smokeless Grilling, Adjustable Temperature Control to 450F, Dishwasher Safe Removable Nonstick Plates, Black (31605N)
features: GRILL INDOORS OR OUTDOORS: This electric grill is suitable for dry-weather outdoor use or grill inside anytime you want. Enjoy your favorite burgers, steaks, chicken and vegetables with outdoor-grilled flavor virtually smokefree and with minimal mess and cleanup

VIRTUALLY SMOKE-FREE GRILLING: The water-filled base on the outdoor/indoor grill reduces smoke during grilling. The water also catches drippings from the food for easier cleanup so the grill surface is easier to clean
MAKES UP TO 8 SERVINGS: This virtually smokeless indoor grill has plenty of room for multiple servings of food — perfect for family meals. It will hold up to eight 4 oz. uncooked hamburger patties
LOCK IN FLAVOR & JUICES WITH HIGH HEAT: The electric grill lets you sear foods on high heat for better taste, texture and appearance. The temperature is fully adjustable from warm up to 450 degrees F
EASY CLEANUP: The nonstick grill plate and base are both dishwasher safe. Just detach the cord before placing in your dishwasher. The nonstick surface also easily wipes clean
description: The Hamilton Beach Serving smokeless electric indoor grill is designed to create less smoke and less mess while you prepare your favorite foods. The grill's high heat quickly seals in the juices of the foods, enhancing the flavor of dishes both hearty and healthy.
